tenderSchedule.title: Supply, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of High Mast lighting system, Solar Lighting and providing illumination to Transformer Bay of ODY at MGHE Power House-Jogfalls-577435,Karnataka
tenderSchedule.description: Supply, erection, testing and commissioning of 14meter octagonal pole type Motorized High Mast illumination system with 250W LED light (06Nos.) along with MLCP, Supports, Foundation, civil works, earthing with complete accessories, luminaries, installation materials, associated equipment etc., with all leads and lifts at front side of MGHE Power House. Supply, erection, testing & commissioning of 10meter High Mast Lighting with 200W LED lights (06 Nos.) along with panel board, Ladder for climbing, Supports, Foundation, Civil works, earthing with complete accessories, luminaries, installation materials, associated equipment etc., with all leads and lifts at Back Yard of MGHE Power House. Laying & termination of 4 Sq.mm 4 core, 1.1KV grade Armored PVC insulated LT UG copper cable from nearest Power Source to High Mast control box and all required accessories for laying the cable to be provided. Supply, installation, testing & commissioning of 12 V DC, 120W LED Solar Street lighting system with 5 meter pole, complete accessories, installation materials with all leads & lifts at various areas of MGHE Power House. Providing illumination to Transformer bay with 34 lighting points including supply of junction boxes, saddles, PVC pipe, HDPE pipe, industrial plug and socket panel, MCBs and all necessary accessories required for providing lighting points. Note- Cable required for power supply from ACDB source to Transformer bay lighting Distribution Box will be provided by KPCL. Supply & installation of 100 W LED Flood light along with fittings.

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The Tenderer is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of eProcurement Portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at Tenderers end

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
For successful bidder, the EMD will be returned, only after entering into agreement and furnishes the contract performance guarantee in an acceptable form
EMD furnished by the bidder will be forfeited in case the bidder withdraws the offer during the validity or violates any clause stipulated in the bid
Tenderers shall not be under declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by the Government of Karnataka
If the Tenderer makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection
KPCL reserve the right to reject any or all tenders received without assigning any reason
Rates shall be quoted in Price Schedule (Financial bid) in the website itself and not upload the same in technical bid, failing which Tender will be rejected
Tenderer shall quote rates exclusive of GST
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification
The Tenderer shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax at the prevailing applicable rates

Any other job not specifically mentioned but reasonably implied to be executed for satisfactory completion of the job in all respects shall have to be carried out by the Contractor without any extra coast. Decision of Engineer-in-charge shall be final and binding in this regard
Corrigendum / modification / corrections, if any, will be published in the eProcurement Portal web site only
Bidders are advised to visit the work site ie MGHE Power House, Jogfalls 577435 before bidding to obtain hands on information, about the quantum of work involved, from the concerned division head

Further information if required can be obtained from office of the Executive Engineer (EM&O), MGHE Works, KPCL, Jog falls- 577435.Section I, II, III, IV, Instruction to bidders, Form of Bid, and Self declaration are part of the Tender document.
After evaluation of Technical Bid and whose offer meet the PQR and technical specification of the tender/bid in complete manner will be accepted and only such bidders Financial bid will be opened

Prices for each item specified in work estimate shall be uploaded in the e-portal itself. Prices will be evaluated based on the rates quoted in the e-portal i.e., the sum total price of items forming the total bid amount. Note Rates per unit quoted shall be FOR destination basis and exclusive of prevailing GST, inclusive of packing forwarding, loading, unloading, transportation, freight and insurance charges and any other allowances.
Right to accept or reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason is reserved by the undersigned.
The bidder shall quote in Indian Rupees only. The bidder shall quote his rates including/inclusive of all the applicable taxes as per the latest GOK/GOI orders.
The quantity of materials and work mentioned/indicated in tender may vary depending on the final requirement at the time of placing the work order.

The bidder or their erection sub contractor should have independent PF registration certificate obtained from PF authorities. If the erection work is executed through erection sub contractor then, same has to be got approved from KPCL before taking up the work by duly furnishing PF registration certificate. Copy of PF remittance challan should be furnished along with the erection bills while releasing the payment. If contractor is not eligible for PF registration, Notary declaration on Rs. 200 stamp paper shall be furnished.

KPCL reserves the right to verify the authenticity of any or all the certificates furnished by any or all the tenders from the authorities who have issued the same. If it is found that any of the agency/agencies have furnished false certificates/ information, the tenders submitted by them are liable for rejection.

Make: Havels/Bajaj/Philips/Wipro

High Mast lighting system of 10 m length:
Supply, erection, testing & commissioning of 10meter High Mast Lighting with 200W LED lights (06 Nos.) along with panel board, Ladder for climbing, Supports, Foundation, Civil works, earthing with complete accessories, luminaries, installation materials, associated equipment etc., with all leads and lifts at Back Yard of MGHE Power House as per the Section-IV of tender document.

Amount quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other levies and duties.

Supply, installation, testing & commissioning of 12 V DC, 120W LED Solar Street lighting system with5 meter pole, complete accessories, installation materials with all leads & lifts at various areas of MGHE Power House as per the Section-IV of tender document.
Amount quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other levies and duties.

Providing illumination to Transformer bay with 34 lighting points including supply of junction boxes, saddles, PVC pipe, HDPE pipe, industrial plug and socket panel, MCBs and all necessary accessories required for providing lighting points.
 Note- Cable required for power supply from ACDB source to Transformer bay lighting Distribution Box will be provided by KPCL as per the Section-IV of tender document. Amount quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other levies and duties.

Supply & installation of 100 W LED Flood light along with fittings make: Wipro/Havells/Bajaj/Philips/Syska/Samsung as per the Section-IV of tender document.
Amount quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other levies and duties.
